messages:
zoe: Noticing higher tail latencies on embeddings write path after config bump to connection_pool=50. I prepared a hotpatch to pin pool=25 and adjust backpressure. Requesting expedited staging deploy -> quick smoke -> prod if green. Need ops + eng OK to fast-track. /cc @ops-ian @sre-maya

deploy-bot: Deployment request queued: release/embeds-config-hotfix@v0.0.3 -> staging. Required approvals: [ops, eng]. Approve via `approve deploy 1987654322` or https://deploy.local/1987654322

ops-ian: What's the blast radius and rollback steps? Can we avoid a full rollback with traffic throttling?

zoe: Blast radius: embeddings write-only pods in us-west1 and us-east1 (approx 6% traffic). Rollback: revert to tag `embeds:config-v0.0.2` if p99 write latency > +300ms or error rate > 0.3% for 3m. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback release/embeds-config@v0.0.2 --env=staging`. Alternative mitigation: enable ingress throttling via `/ops throttle embeds-writes --rate=200rps`

sre-maya: I'll take ops approval for staging. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

eng-lead-rob: I approve from eng on the condition we run the 5-check smoke suite and verify embedding correctness on 2 sample corpuses.

zoe: Smoke checklist:
- run write-load 5k items/min for 2m
- confirm ingestion pipeline ack rates > 99%
- p95/p99 write latency within thresholds
- sample verify embedding vectors for 2 queries (no drift)
- logging: collect traces for any 5xx

pm-anya: PM note: update incident RED-4999 and pre-approve customer note. Draft: "Temporary fix to reduce connection pool size to address intermittent write latency."

releasebot: Release note draft saved: "embeds: reduce connection pool to mitigate tail write latency (v0.0.3)". PM review requested @pm-anya

zoe: Triggering staging deploy (skip canary requested). Command:
```
/deploy release/embeds-config-hotfix@v0.0.3 --env=staging --skip-canary --tag=hotfix-1987654322
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/embeds-config-hotfix@v0.0.3 -> staging
- step: image pull -> gcr.io/redwood/embeds:hotfix-1987654322
- step: kube rollout restart on staging embeddings deployment
- step: health checks enabled
logs: https://deploy.local/1987654322/logs

zoe: Staging up. Running smoke suite now.

sre-maya: write-load 5k/min -> PASS. Ack rates 99.6%. p95 within baseline, p99 improved by ~80ms.

eng-lead-rob: Sample embeddings look consistent (no drift). Good to promote to prod if ops is comfortable.

ops-ian: I want 10m quiet monitoring in staging then a small 1% prod slice with 10m watch. Approve prod progression after that.

zoe: Roger. Waiting 10m, then will promote with traffic-split 1% -> 10% -> 100% with gates.

(10m)

zoe: Staging quiet for 10m. Initiating prod rollout: `/deploy release/embeds-config-hotfix@v0.0.3 --env=prod --traffic-split=1,10,100 --gates=10m`

deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. Health gates: abort on p99 write latency +300ms or error rate > 0.3% over 3m. Auto-rollback enabled.

ops-ian: Observing 1% slice. No anomalies. Advancing to 10%.

zoe: 10% steady for 12m. No error spikes. Advancing to 100%.

eng-lead-rob: 100% complete. Confirming post-deploy checks: p95/p99 within targets, no vector drift.

sre-maya: Monitoring for 30m then will close the incident. Good job. :tada:

pm-anya: Release note approved and incident RED-4999 marked as resolved pending final watch.

zoe: Thanks team. Will follow up with a short retro on what made the config change risky and propose a guardrail.

releasebot: Release tagged and published: embeds-config-hotfix@v0.0.3 -> prod. Changelog appended.
